chapter.verse: Tu-in sanggamte aw, kha thuphate tawh kisai a theilo na hih ding uh kong deihsak kei hi.
Thu-umlo na hih lai-un nuntakna neilo milimte lamah nam khat teitei tawh na pialkhia uh hi.

Tua hangin Pasian' Kha tawh a pau ahih nakleh kuamah in, “Jesu haamsiat tuak hen!” ci ngeilo a, Kha Siangtho tawh lo-in kuamah in, “Jesu pen Topa hi,” ci theilo cih thu na theihtel ding uh ka deih hi.
Tu-in hehpihna gah a tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin Kha khat bek ahi hi.
Tanuk nasep a tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin Topa khat bek ahi hi.
Mapanna a tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin tuate khempeuh mi kim' sungah a gamtangsak pen Pasian khat bek ahi hi.
Tangpi phattuamna a om nadingin mi khat ciat in Kha kilatkhiatna ngah tek hi.
Mi khat in Kha panin pilna ngah a, a dang khat in tua Kha pan mahin thutheihna,
a dang khat in tua Kha pan mahin upna, a dang khat in tua Kha khat pan mahin natdamsak hehpihna gah,
a dang khat in nalamdang bawlna, a dang khat in kamsanna, a dang khat in kha khentelna, a dang khat in kamtuam pauna, a dang khat in kamphenna, cih bangin ngah hi.
Hihte khempeuh bawlin khat ciat' tungah ama' hoihsak bangin a guan pen Kha khat bek ahi hi.
Pumpi khat bek in pumpi na tampi nei-in tua pumpi nate tampi hinapi a vekun pumpi khat ahih mah bangin Khris zong tua dan ahi hi.

A hang pen eite khempeuh—Jew mi, Greek mi, sila, tualmi suakta, kuakua i hi zongin—i vekpi-in pumpi khat sungah Kha khat bek tawh hong kibaptize ahi hi. I vekpi-in Kha khat bek mah tawh a kidiah dingin hong kibawl hi.
Pumpi cihna ah pumpi na khat bek hilo-in tampi kihel hi.
Khe in, “Kei pen khut hilo ka hih manin pumpi tawh ka kisai kei hi,” ci hileh tua in pumpi ah a kihelna kiamsak lo hi.
Bil in, “Kei pen mit hilo ka hih manin pumpi tawh ka kisai kei hi,” ci hileh tua in pumpi ah a kihelna kiamsak lo hi.
Pumpi bup mit bekbek hi zenzen leh koi pan khuaza ding ahi hiam? Pumpi bup bil bekbek hi zenzen leh koi pan a gimnam ngah ding ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin tu-a i neih bangin Pasian in pumpi nate khat ciat ama' ngimna bangin hong guansak hi.
Vekpi-in pumpi na nam khat bek hi mawk leh pumpi koi ah om ding ahi hiam?
Tu-a i neih bangin pumpi na tampi om a, ahi zongin pumpi pen khat bek ahi hi.
Mit in khut kiangah, “Nang kong kisam kei hi,” ci theilo ding a, lutang in zong khe kiangah, “Nang kong kisam kei hi,” ci theilo ding hi.
Tua ding hilo-in pumpi na ginalo tawh a kibangte a phamawh teng nahizaw hi.
Pumpina thupi lo i sakte i pibawl ding hizaw a, a etlawmlo munte i thudonzawk ding ahi hi.
Tua pen a etlawm munte' ading kisam lo hi. Himah taleh Pasian in i pumpi tua bangin hong buptuahsak hi a, thudon a ngahlo pumpi nate pibawlzaw hi.
Pumpi sungah kikhenkakna om lo-in pumpi nate khatlekhat a kidon tek ahih nading uh deihna ahi hi.
Pumpina khat in gimna thuak leh a vekpi-un a thuakkhawm uh hi a, pumpi na khat kipahtawi leh a vekpi-un a lungdamkhawm uh ahi hi.
Tu-in note pen Khris' pumpi na hi uh a, tua pumpi ah a kihel tek na hi uh hi.

Pasian in zong pawlpi sungah a masa-in sawltakpite, nihna ah kamsangte, thumna ah hilhcian syate, a zom ah nalamdangte, a zom ah hehpihna gahte ahi damsakna, mihuhna, thu vaihawmna, leh kamtuam paunate, cih bangin guan hi.
Vekpi-in sawltakpi kihi hiam? Vekpi-in kamsang kihi hiam? Vekpi-in hilhcian sya kihi hiam? Vekpi-in nalamdang kibawl hiam?
Vekpi-in natdamsak hehpihna gah nei i hi hiam? Vekpi-in kamtuam kipau hiam? Vekpi-in kamphen kisem hiam?
Himah taleh hehpihna gah a thupizawte deihbelin na nei un. Tua hileh a hoihzaw mahmah khat kong lak ding hi.
